message.content: {"note_claim": "The UK is pursuing a policy of defensive operations to protect overseas bases, while allowing the US to conduct air strikes on missile sites from UK bases.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "we have given permission for US forces to use long standing basing at RAF Fairford and Diego Garcia to support defensive strikes against the ballistic missiles that are targeting the Gulf.", "reason": "The page directly confirms the UK is conducting defensive operations and has permitted US use of UK bases for strikes against ballistic missiles, while explicitly noting the Cyprus base is not used in those operations."}

parsed.note_claim: The UK is pursuing a policy of defensive operations to protect overseas bases, while allowing the US to conduct air strikes on missile sites from UK bases.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: we have given permission for US forces to use long standing basing at RAF Fairford and Diego Garcia to support defensive strikes against the ballistic missiles that are targeting the Gulf.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms the UK is conducting defensive operations and has permitted US use of UK bases for strikes against ballistic missiles, while explicitly noting the Cyprus base is not used in those operations.
